name: Tuomo Suntola
summary: Finnish inventor and pioneer of atomic layer epitaxy (later atomic layer deposition).

name: Thor Stubb
summary: Professor at Helsinki University of Technology who supervised Suntola’s early work.

name: Instrumentarium Oy
summary: Finnish medical‑instrument company that funded the early ALE research.

name: Lohja Oy
summary: Building‑material company that took over the ALE‑EL project in 1978.

name: Microchemistry Ltd.
summary: Spin‑off company founded in 1987 to develop ALE for solar cells and catalysis.

name: ASM Microchemistry
summary: Dutch company that acquired Microchemistry Ltd. in 1999.

name: Picosun Oy
summary: Finnish ALE‑reactor company co‑founded by former Microchemistry staff.

name: Beneq Oy
summary: Company that continued ALE‑EL production after Planar’s acquisition.

name: International patent FIN 52359 (ALE)
summary: First patent covering atomic layer epitaxy, filed 29 Nov 1974.

name: F‑120 reactor
summary: Compact ALE reactor developed in the early 1990s, the first commercial ALD reactor.

name: Helsinki University of Technology
summary: University where Suntola studied electrical engineering and earned his doctorate.

name: SID conference, San Diego 1980
summary: First public demonstration of ALE‑EL displays.
